definition-changed.answer: Class alphabetic/alphanumeric is the same Table 3 rows in both. The open 2002 reading of a numeric or boolean USAGE NATIONAL item (§2002:8.5.2.7 item 3 vs §2002:8.5.2.9; PB5625 Reading 2) places such an item in class numeric/boolean or national, never alphabetic or alphanumeric, so it is refused under either reading; probe r08-natof-n9.cob refuses it (COBOL1546) at 2002. Scope unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: The rule has no arithmetic: §2002:8.8.1.x (standard arithmetic) does not enter an argument-class rule; NATIONAL-OF's returned-value length (RV4) is outside AR1. §2002:15/15.1 differ from 2023 15.1/15.2 only in function-type text about the returned item (§2002:15.1 'The number of character positions in this data item is specified in the function definition'); the one argument-type difference (§2002:15.2 AR8 'of usage national' vs 2023 'of class national') is the class question of the other flag. No dependence.
